Category.Name: ImageFormatControl
Category.ToolTip: Contains parameters to control the size of the acquired image and the format of the transferred pixel data.
Category.Description: Contains parameters to control the size of the acquired image and the format of the transferred pixel data.

Integer.Name: SensorWidth
Integer.ToolTip: Width of the device's sensor in pixels.
Integer.Description: Width of the device's sensor in pixels.

Integer.Name: WidthMax
Integer.ToolTip: Maximum width of the image (in pixels).
Integer.Description: Maximum width of the image (in pixels).

Boolean.Name: ReverseX
Boolean.ToolTip: Enables horizontal flipping of the image.
Boolean.Description: Enables horizontal flipping of the image.

Enumeration.Name: TestPattern
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the type of test pattern that is generated by the device as image source.
Enumeration.Description: Selects the type of test pattern that is generated by the device as image source.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is coming from the sensor.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is coming from the sensor.

EnumEntry.Name: Black
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is filled with the darkest possible image.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is filled with the darkest possible image.

EnumEntry.Name: White
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is filled with the brightest possible image.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is filled with the brightest possible image.

EnumEntry.Name: GreyHorizontalRamp
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest.

EnumEntry.Name: GreyHorizontalRampMoving
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and that moves horizontally from left to right at each frame.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is filled horizontally with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and that moves horizontally from left to right at each frame.

EnumEntry.Name: GreyVerticalRampMoving
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Image is filled vertically with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and that moves verticaly from top to bottom at each frame.
EnumEntry.Description: Image is filled vertically with an image that goes from the darkest possible value to the brightest and that moves verticaly from top to bottom at each frame.

Enumeration.Name: PixelFormat
Enumeration.ToolTip: Format of the pixels provided by the device.
Enumeration.Description: Format of the pixels provided by the device. It represents all the information provided by PixelSize, PixelColorFilter combined in a single feature.

EnumEntry.Name: Mono8
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Monochrome 8-bit

EnumEntry.Name: Mono10p
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Monochrome 10-bit packed

Enumeration.Name: PixelSize
Enumeration.ToolTip: Total size in bits of a pixel of the image.
Enumeration.Description: Total size in bits of a pixel of the image.

EnumEntry.Name: Bpp8
EnumEntry.ToolTip: 8 bits per pixel.

EnumEntry.Name: Bpp10
EnumEntry.ToolTip: 10 bits per pixel.

Enumeration.Name: PixelSizeA
Enumeration.ToolTip: Total size in bits of a pixel of the image.
Enumeration.Description: Total size in bits of a pixel of the image.

EnumEntry.Name: Bpp8
EnumEntry.ToolTip: 8 bits per pixel.

EnumEntry.Name: Bpp10
EnumEntry.ToolTip: 10 bits per pixel.

Integer.Name: Width
Integer.ToolTip: Sets the width of the function area of interest in pixels.
Integer.Description: This value sets the width of the function area of interest in pixels.

Integer.Name: Height
Integer.ToolTip: Sets the height of the function area of interest in pixels.
Integer.Description: This value sets the height of the function area of interest in pixels.

Integer.Name: OffsetX
Integer.ToolTip: Sets the starting column of the function area of interest in pixels.
Integer.Description: This value sets the starting column of the function area of interest in pixels.

Enumeration.Name: BinningHorizontalMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the binning horizontal mode.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the binning horizontal mode.

EnumEntry.Name: Sum
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The values of the binned pixels are summed.
EnumEntry.Description: The values of the binned pixels are summed. This increases the camera's response to light and the signal-to-noise ratio.

EnumEntry.Name: Average
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The values of the binned pixels are averaged.
EnumEntry.Description: The values of the binned pixels are averaged. This increases the signal-to-noise ratio without changing the camera's response to light.

Integer.Name: BinningHorizontal
Integer.ToolTip: Number of Horizontal pixels to combine together.
Integer.Description: Number of Horizontal pixels to combine together.

Category.Name: AcquisitionControl
Category.ToolTip: Features related to actual image acquision

Enumeration.Name: AcquisitionMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the acquisition mode of the device.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the acquisition mode of the device.

Command.Name: AcquisitionStart
Command.Description: Starts the acquisition of images. If the camera is set for single frame acquisition, it will start acquisition of one frame. If the camera is set for continuous frame acquisition, it will start continuous acquisition of frames.

Command.Name: AcquisitionStop
Command.Description: Stops the acquisition of images if the camera is set for continuous image acquisition and acquisition has been started.

Enumeration.Name: ExposureMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the operation mode of the Exposure.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the operation mode of the Exposure.

EnumEntry.Name: Timed
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Timed exposure.
EnumEntry.Description: Timed exposure. The exposure duration time is set using the ExposureTime or ExposureAuto features and the exposure starts with the FrameStart or LineStart.

EnumEntry.Name: TriggerWidth
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Uses the width of the current Frame or Line trigger signal(s) pulse to control the exposure duration.
EnumEntry.Description: Uses the width of the current Frame or Line trigger signal(s) pulse to control the exposure duration. Note that if the Frame or Line TriggerActivation is RisingEdge or LevelHigh, the exposure duration will be the time the trigger stays High. If TriggerActivation is FallingEdge or LevelLow, the exposure time will last as long as the trigger stays Low.

Enumeration.Name: ExposureTimeMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the configuration mode of the ExposureTime feature.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the configuration mode of the ExposureTime feature.

EnumEntry.Name: Common
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The exposure time is common to all the color components.
EnumEntry.Description: The exposure time is common to all the color components. The common ExposureTime value to use can be set selecting it with ExposureTimeSelector[Common].

Float.Name: InternalLineRate
Float.Description: Specifies the camera line rate (Hz), when exposure mode is Timed.

Float.Name: MeasuredExtTriggerRate
Float.ToolTip: Measured external trigger rate in Hz.
Float.Description: Measured external trigger rate in Hz.

Enumeration.Name: LineTriggerMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the mode for the currently selected line trigger.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the mode for the currently selected line trigger.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected line trigger is turned off.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected line trigger is turned off, it is only available when Exposure Time Source is Timed.

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected line trigger is turned on.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected line trigger is turned on.

Enumeration.Name: LineTriggerSource
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the trigger source for the selected line trigger.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the trigger source for the selected line trigger.

Enumeration.Name: LineTriggerActivation
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the signal transition that activates the selected line trigger.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the signal transition that activates the selected line trigger.

EnumEntry.Name: RisingEdge
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The selected line trigger is activated on the rising edge of the source signal.
EnumEntry.Description: The selected line trigger is activated on the rising edge of the source signal.

EnumEntry.Name: FallingEdge
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The selected line trigger is activated on the falling edge of the source signal.
EnumEntry.Description: The selected line trigger is activated on the falling edge of the source signal.

EnumEntry.Name: LevelHigh
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is high.
EnumEntry.Description: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is high.

EnumEntry.Name: LevelLow
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is low.
EnumEntry.Description: Specifies that the trigger is considered valid as long as the level of the source signal is low.

Integer.Name: LineTriggerDivider
Integer.ToolTip: Specifies a division factor for the incoming trigger pulses.
Integer.Description: Specifies a division factor for the incoming trigger pulses.
